_usage_note: Append the master negative prompt array to ALL image prompts without exception. Per-mood additions are appended on top of the master array for specific scene types.
_source: Blueprint Section 3, v2 addition — peer-review corrected edition

master_negative_prompt.label: Master Negative Prompt — append to ALL image prompts
master_negative_prompt.prompt_text: Western facial features, European skin tone, light skin, blonde hair, blue eyes, anime style, cartoon, illustration, watermark, text overlay, extra fingers, bad anatomy, deformed hands, ugly, blurry, low quality, oversaturated, neon colours, modern Western clothing unless specified, crowded background clutter, inconsistent lighting

supernatural.label: Supernatural — additional negatives
additional_terms: realistic eyes on Ada (Phase 2 amber glow allowed)

covenant_villain.label: Covenant / Villain — additional negatives
additional_terms: casual clothing on Chief Mrs. Adeyemi

never_generate: Ada without the scar above left eyebrow
Ada smiling broadly in Phase 2 or Phase 3
Ada without gold anklet in Phase 3 (episodes 19-50)
Ada with light skin or non-Nigerian features
Ada in Phase 1 clothing during Phase 3 episodes
Zion in casual or non-luxury clothing
Chief Mrs. Adeyemi in Western clothing
Chief Mrs. Adeyemi without gele headwrap (unless scene specifically requires it)
Chief Mrs. Adeyemi with an unguarded genuine smile
Chief Mrs. Adeyemi without heavy gold jewellery
Amara in dark muted clothing (must contrast Ada with bright Ankara)
The Blind Woman with normal coloured eyes or visible iris
The Blind Woman in anything other than simple white wrapper cloth
The Blind Woman in an urban or modern setting (wilderness and village only)
Senator Balogun with a genuine warm smile

safety_refusal_rewording._note: M3 includes 3 automatic prompt rewording variants to retry on safety filter refusals.
